findings.title: Repeated no-change predicate contradicts actual normalizer branches
proposal_locations: MD ordered catalog preamble and future T02/T08 as affected
findings.evidence: The repeated text says current helpers return for absent/nonobject input. N24/N25 return early only if current is null AND original is null AND derived entries are empty; other faction sidecars have related compound predicates. They can materialize absent sidecars from original/current core. Guardians explicitly handles JsonArray; resident/chronicle/quest/faction/actor-journal methods do not universally reject nonobject roots before projection. N03 appends power journal only when entries exist; no-entry repair belongs to N06.
findings.impact: A false no-change witness can omit a required candidate contribution or change source behavior in future EP planning. This is a source-catalog defect, not a runtime reproduction or a claim every array is valid under full Chaos validators.
findings.required_correction: Audit all 40 rows and replace shared boilerplate with exact owner-specific skip/write/no-change predicates. Distinguish current absence, original presence, derived companion inputs, supported root shapes, equal projected serialization, and failed required validation. Attribute no-entry power-journal repair to N06. Extend future checks for absent sidecar with populated original/core, array projection, genuine empty compound predicate and invalid authority. Preserve original pair; publish new corrected pair.

findings.title: Accepted-health profile mirror publication owner omitted before A02
findings.evidence: EnsureClientOwnedSystemFilesHealthyCoreAsync calls RefreshGameStateAsync before system-mod health. Refresh invokes ApplyPlayerSoulProfileClientAuthorityForRefreshAsync before live aggregation. This is a conditional writer of afterlife_entity_profiles from profile/soul/Shining inputs, with original-writer vs trusted-local dispatch, exact-byte no-op preservation, publication uncertainty and retained recovery obligations. N16 is a later distinct normalization stage; its same destination does not represent this earlier owner.
findings.impact: The surrounding-owner inventory omits a directly invoked mutating owner and its phase, overlap, publication-debt and runtime-state obligations. Declared incomplete transitive reads do not identify this already-visible writer; treating it as generic read/cache refresh risks a missing or duplicated contribution.
findings.required_correction: Add an explicit ordered health owner before A02, with the three logical input roots, profile destination, exact optional-reader/no-change predicates, whole-root projection scope, original/trusted-local dispatch, recovery-before/after publication, exception policy, and subsequent live aggregation obligation. Compose its result with N16 and any actual C4 ownership under Q-E2/Q-E3; keep typed complete evaluation integration unaccepted. Add future cases for no-op/change/absent or unusable input, original vs local dispatch, uncertainty/retained cleanup, N16 overlap and live refresh gating. Keep complete aggregation read closure OPEN rather than claiming invented full scope.
